parsed.rationale: 68-year-old with COPD reporting 2 days of progressive dyspnea now occurring with minimal exertion (walking to bathroom) plus purulent green sputum — findings consistent with an acute COPD exacerbation, likely infective. Needs same-day in-person assessment with oxygen saturation measurement, lung exam, and consideration of steroids/antibiotics; this exceeds what async review can safely manage, but she is not describing frank respiratory failure (no confusion, cyanosis, or inability to speak) requiring immediate emergency activation.
